purpose: Converts physical input into rebinding-aware, semantic player actions.
description: Processes semantic player actions from input maps, applies player-mode policy and rebinding, and coordinates client/server action state.

PlayerInputCooldownService.luau.description: Automatically maps authoritative action cooldowns onto PlayerInputService restrictions and starts them from completed action executions. Public entry points include `PlayerInputCooldownService.Init`, `PlayerInputCooldownService.Start`, `PlayerInputCooldownService.Bind`, `PlayerInputCooldownService.BindAction`, `PlayerInputCooldownService.TryStartActionExecution`, `PlayerInputCooldownService.IsActionOnCooldown`,…

PlayerInputService.luau.description: Validates compact semantic input reports and provides authoritative contexts, restrictions, server binding overrides, and input observations. Public entry points include `PlayerInputService.Init`, `PlayerInputService.Start`, `PlayerInputService.RegisterActor`, `PlayerInputService.ObserveActorsBrio`, `PlayerInputService.SetGlobalServerInputRateLimit`, `PlayerInputService.SetGlobalNetworkRateLimit`,…

Server/PlayerInputActorModel.luau.description: Owns one Player or NPC Model's authoritative input policy, rate limiters, held action state, and optional player binding overrides. Public entry points include `PlayerInputActorModel.new`, `PlayerInputActorModel.ProcessInput`, `PlayerInputActorModel.TryInput`, `PlayerInputActorModel.PushContext`, `PlayerInputActorModel.PushRestriction`, `PlayerInputActorModel.IsInputHeld`, `PlayerInputActorModel.ForceRelease`,…
